title: Staged deployment quality guard with automated revert policy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: implement a staged-deployment quality guard that continuously evaluates a small production cohort after any model or serving-config change and automatically reverts traffic if regression signals exceed thresholds. This ticket covers the control-plane orchestration, evaluation harness integration, metric selection and thresholds, and safe revert mechanics. Scope includes: (1) canary cohort wiring that isolates 1-5% traffic to a candidate model/config; (2) a real-time eval pipeline that runs our scoring set (unit prompts + production sampled queries) and computes quality deltas (BLEU-like, embed-sim, hallucination-rate proxy, latency and tail-p99 token cost); (3) a decision controller that applies hysteresis, minimum sample counts, and multi-metric priority weighting to avoid noisy rollbacks; (4) an automated revert executor with throttled traffic un-shifting and post-revert notifications; (5) observability dashboards and alerting for false positives and noisy signals. This is intended to be model-agnostic (works for text-gen, chat, and reranker variants) and compatible with both hosted and Dedicated deployments. Implementation should prioritize safety: any auto-revert must be reversible and logged to our audit trail with a linkable runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Control plane creates a staged cohort that routes 1% and 5% traffic to candidate variant by config flag
Eval pipeline ingests sampled traffic and scoring set within 30s of request and produces delta metrics every minute
Decision controller triggers an automated revert when: (a) quality delta crosses configured threshold AND (b) minimum sample size met AND (c) metric hysteresis check passes
Automated revert executes in <90s and restores previous variant with staged ramp-down; all actions recorded in audit log
Dashboard shows real-time delta trends, sample counts, and rollback history for each staged deploy; onboard docs and runbook added
tasks: Design metric contract and thresholds with Eval team
Add cohort routing flags to runtime routing policy
Build streaming eval ingestion hook into observability pipeline
Implement decision controller with unit tests and safety gates
Add automated revert executor and audit logging
Create dashboard panels and alerting rules
Run chaos + false-positive simulations in staging
